dedupe_keys.name: chongqing swan radar quantitative precipitation estimates 2016 2023

description: Science Data Bank publishes radar quantitative precipitation estimates produced by the National Meteorological Center's Severe Weather Automatically Nowcast System (SWAN). The named release covers the Chongqing area, 27–33° N and 104–111° E, using four S-band and one C-band radar. Its grid is 0.01° by 0.01° every six minutes from March 2016 through October 2021, then March through October 2023. The public record lists one large data file; it does not describe a 2022 series. Urban-drainage, river-flood or landslide-exposure models could use the gridded rainfall as event forcing or compare it with gauges. Radar estimates are not gauge measurements, and the 2022 gap and seasonal 2023 coverage restrict continuous trend analysis. The own Science Data Bank page is public and DataCite states CC BY-NC 4.0, so reuse is free subject to the non-commercial condition. No file was downloaded, so the internal data format and missing-cell coding remain unverified. This regional, fine-scale input complements the catalogue's RRI rainfall-runoff-inundation model; it is different from the NASA global half-hourly IMERG product also cited by the article.
name: Chongqing SWAN radar quantitative precipitation estimates, 2016–2023
notes: G3 G3-0652. Draft only. No resource files downloaded or software executed. Science Data Bank's page lists a 1.29 GB file but its internal format was not opened. The 2022 gap is explicit in the own metadata. CC BY-NC 4.0 excludes commercial reuse without other permission.
